# KAVACHQ by GAINT

> KAVACHQ by GAINT (also written KAVACH-Q or KAVACH Q) is a quantum-safe cybersecurity and post-quantum cryptography (PQC) migration platform built by GAINT Clout Technologies Private Limited, a technology company based in Hyderabad, Telangana, India.

KAVACHQ by GAINT is not affiliated with "KavachQ" at kavachq.in, which is a separate product by V Innovation Labs.

## What it does
- Cryptographic discovery: finds the algorithms, certificates and keys an organisation uses.
- Quantum risk scoring: ranks assets by exposure to future quantum attacks.
- Migration planning: sequences the move to NIST post-quantum standards (ML-KEM, ML-DSA, SLH-DSA).
- Compliance reporting: produces evidence for management, auditors and regulators.
